comparison.objective: Fill three drywall nail holes with spackle and strike the patches flush.
comparison.physical_skill: Load and angle a putty knife, pack material, and regulate scraping depth without tearing paper.
comparison.success_condition: All holes filled within depth tolerance, minimal proud material, no damaging corner drag, knife set down for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Material deposition and surface finishing are unrelated to supported rigid-body transfer and rolling-element containment.
